name: Minnesota
agency: County or tribal human services agency (Minnesota DHS)

period.description: For people who are 65+, blind or disabled, the spenddown is a monthly amount, checked month by month within a six-month renewal period.

submission.description: Most providers bill Medical Assistance, which takes your spenddown off your first claims each month; give other bills to your county worker. You can also prepay your monthly spenddown to DHS (Client Option Spenddown) by mail or online.

notes: If you prepay your spenddown, DHS later compares it with what MA paid and refunds overpaid months.
You must pay providers the part of your bills that meets the spenddown; MA then pays covered care.
People using certain services, like PCA, may be able to pay their spenddown to one chosen provider.
